name: Kaminari Taiko
source: A Kaminari Taiko type monster girl. Kaminari Taiko means thunder drum and this Kaminari Taiko carries a drum which she can use to summon vicious lightning attacks. A very tough wizard she attacks [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] early and often for [url=http://vndb.org/c13604]Baron Squid[/url] but is always thwarted by [url=http://vndb.org/c13594]Valkyrie[/url].
